name: PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk
summary: PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in trading and investment in the energy sector. The company operates through two segments: Energy and Mining. The Mining segment engages in coal mining and related services in Indonesia. The Energy segment provides special port services and contractor mining services. The company also engages in oil and gas investment and operations; and nickel mining. PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk was formerly known as PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk and changed its name to PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk in June 2026. PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk was founded in 1968 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
